an10.93:1.1: ekaṃ samayaṃ bhagavā sāvatthiyaṃ viharati jetavane anāthapiṇḍikassa ārāme.
an10.93:1.2: athakho anāthapiṇḍiko gahapati divādivassa sāvatthiyā nikkhami bhagavantaṃ dassanāya
an10.93:1.8: yannūnāhaṃ yena aññatitthiyānaṃ paribbājakānaṃ ārāmo tenupasaṅkameyyanti
an10.93:2.1: athakho anāthapiṇḍiko gahapati yena aññatitthiyānaṃ paribbājakānaṃ ārāmo tenupasaṅkami.
an10.93:2.2: tena kho pana samayena aññatitthiyā paribbājakā saṃgamma samāgamma unnādino uccāsaddā mahāsaddā anekavihitaṃ tiracchānakathaṃ kathentā nisinnā honti
an10.93:2.3: addasaṃsu kho te aññatitthiyā paribbājakā anāthapiṇḍikaṃ gahapatiṃ dūratova āgacchantaṃ
an10.93:2.5: appasaddā bhonto hontu mā bhonto saddamakattha
an10.93:2.6: ayaṃ anāthapiṇḍiko gahapati āgacchati samaṇassa gotamassa sāvako
an10.93:2.7: yāvatā kho pana samaṇassa gotamassa sāvakā gihī odātavasanā sāvatthiyaṃ paṭivasanti ayaṃ tesaṃ aññataro anāthapiṇḍiko gahapati
an10.93:2.8: appasaddakāmā kho pana te āyasmanto appasaddavinītā appasaddassa vaṇṇavādino
an10.93:2.9: appeva nāma appasaddaṃ parisaṃ viditvā upasaṅkamitabbaṃ maññeyyāti
an10.93:3.2: athakho anāthapiṇḍiko gahapati yena te paribbājakā tenupasaṅkami upasaṅkamitvā tehi aññatitthiyehi paribbājakehi saddhiṃ sammodi
an10.93:3.3: sammodanīyaṃ kathaṃ sārāṇīyaṃ vītisāretvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi. ekamantaṃ nisinnaṃ kho anāthapiṇḍikaṃ gahapatiṃ te aññatitthiyā paribbājakā etadavocuṃ
an10.93:3.5: na kho ahaṃ bhante bhagavato sabbaṃ diṭṭhiṃ jānāmīti.
an10.93:4.1: idāni kira tvaṃ gahapati na samaṇassa gotamassa sabbaṃ diṭṭhiṃ jānāti
an10.93:4.3: bhikkhūnaṃpi kho ahaṃ bhante na sabbaṃ diṭṭhiṃ jānāmīti.
an10.93:5.1: iti kira tvaṃ gahapati na samaṇassa gotamassa sabbaṃ diṭṭhiṃ jānāsi napi bhikkhūnaṃ sabbaṃ diṭṭhiṃ jānāsi
an10.93:5.3: etaṃ kho bhante amhehi na dukkaraṃ byākātuṃ yaṃdiṭṭhikā mayanti
an10.93:5.4: iṃgha tāva āyasmanto yathāsakāni diṭṭhigatāni byākarontu pacchāpetaṃ amhehi na dukkaraṃ bhavissati byākātuṃ yaṃdiṭṭhikā mayanti.

an10.93:12.1: evaṃ vutte te paribbājakā anāthapiṇḍikaṃ gahapatiṃ etadavocuṃ
an10.93:12.2: byākatāni kho gahapati amhehi sabbeheva yathāsakāni diṭṭhigatāni
an10.93:12.4: yaṃ kho pana bhante kiñci bhūtaṃ saṃkhataṃ cetayitaṃ paṭiccasamuppannaṃ tadaniccaṃ
an10.93:12.6: yaṃ dukkhaṃ taṃ netaṃ mama nesohamasmi na meso attāti
an10.93:13.1: yaṃ kho gahapati kiñci bhūtaṃ saṃkhataṃ cetayitaṃ paṭiccasamuppannaṃ tadaniccaṃ
an10.93:13.3: yaṃ dukkhaṃ tadeva tvaṃ gahapati allīno tadeva tvaṃ gahapati ajjhūpagatoti.
an10.93:14.1: yaṃ kho pana bhante kiñci bhūtaṃ saṃkhataṃ cetayitaṃ paṭiccasamuppannaṃ tadaniccaṃ
an10.93:14.3: yaṃ dukkhaṃ taṃ netaṃ mama nesohamasmi na meso attāti evametaṃ yathābhūtaṃ sammappaññāya sudiṭṭhaṃ
an10.93:14.4: tassa ca uttariṃ nissaraṇaṃ yathābhūtaṃ pajānāmīti.
an10.93:15.1: evaṃ vutte te paribbājakā tuṇhībhūtā maṃkubhūtā pattakkhandhā adhomukhā pajjhāyantā appaṭibhāṇā nisīdiṃsu
an10.93:15.2: athakho anāthapiṇḍiko gahapati te paribbājake tuṇhībhūte maṃkubhūte pattakkhandhe adhomukhe pajjhāyante appaṭibhāṇe viditvā uṭṭhāyāsanā yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkami upasaṅkamitvā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi ekamantaṃ nisinno kho anāthapiṇḍiko gahapati yāvatako ahosi tehi aññatitthiyehi paribbājakehi saddhiṃ kathāsallāpo taṃ sabbaṃ bhagavato ārocesi.
an10.93:15.4: evaṃ kho te gahapati moghapurisā kālena kālaṃ sahadhammena suniggahitaṃ niggahetabbāti
an10.93:16.1: athakho bhagavā anāthapiṇḍikaṃ gahapatiṃ dhammiyā kathāya sandassesi samādapesi samuttejesi sampahaṃsesi.
an10.93:16.2: athakho anāthapiṇḍiko gahapati bhagavatā dhammiyā kathāya sandassito samādapito samuttejito sampahaṃsito uṭṭhāyāsanā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā padakkhiṇaṃ katvā pakkāmi.
an10.93:17.1: athakho bhagavā acirapakkante anāthapiṇḍike gahapatimhi bhikkhū āmantesi
an10.93:17.2: yopi kho bhikkhave bhikkhu dīgharattaṃ avedhidhammo imasmiṃ dhammavinaye sopi evamevaṃ aññatitthiye paribbājake sahadhammena suniggahitaṃ niggaheyya yathātaṃ anāthapiṇḍikena gahapatinā niggahitāti.
